title: Ethereum collapses below $2,000 after Vitalik Buterin and insiders moved millions to exchanges
subTitle:
Ethereum co-founder Vitalik Buterin and other prominent “whales” have offloaded millions of dollars in ETH since the beginning of February, adding narrative fuel to a market rout that saw the world's second-largest cryptocurrency tumble below $2,000.
While the high-profile sales by Buterin served as a psychological trigger for retail panic, a closer examination of market data suggests that the primary pressure came from a systemic unwind of leverage and record-breaking selling activity across the network.
Nonetheless, these disposals, combined with significant selling by other industry insiders, have prompted investors to question whether project leaders are losing confidence or simply managing operational runways amid extreme volatility.
Why is Buterin selling his Ethereum holdings?
In the past 3 days, Buterin sold 6,183 ETH ($13.24M) at an average price of $2,140, according to blockchain analysis platform @lookonchain .

However, the specifics of Buterin’s transactions reveal a calculated, rather than panic-driven, strategy.
Notably, Buterin publicly disclosed that he had set aside 16,384 ETH, valued at approximately $43- $45 million at the time, to be deployed over the coming years.
He stated the funds are earmarked for open-source security, privacy technology, and broader public-good infrastructure as the Ethereum Foundation enters what he described as a period of “mild austerity.”
In this light, the most defensible explanation for “why he sold” is mundane. It appears to be the conversion of a pre-allocated ETH budget into spendable runway (stablecoins) for a multi-year funding plan rather than a sudden attempt to time the market top.
However, the channel through which these sales affect the market is more narrative-driven than liquidity-based. When investors see founder wallets active on the sell side during a downturn, it tilts sentiment and deepens the bearish resolve of an already shaky market.
Still, Buterin remains an ETH whale, holding over 224,105 ETH, which is equivalent to approximately $430 million.
Did Buterin's ETH sales precipitate a market crash?
The central question for investors is whether Buterin’s selling mechanically pushed ETH below $2,000.
From a structural perspective, it is difficult to argue that Buterin's $13.24 million sell program, by itself, breaks a major market level, given ETH's multi-billion-dollar daily trading volume.
So, a sell order of this magnitude is small relative to typical turnover and lacks the volume required to consume order book depth and drive prices down significantly on its own.
However, Buterin was not selling in a vacuum. He was part of a broader exodus of large holders that collectively weighed on the market.
On-chain trackers flagged significant activity from Stani Kulechov, the founder of the DeFi protocol Aave. Kulechov sold 4,503 Ethereum (valued at about $8.36 million) at a price of around $1,857 just hours before ETH's slide accelerated.
This activity is symptomatic of a broader trend. Data from CryptoQuant shows that the network has faced record selling activity this month.

The analytics firm noted that the network had seen an increase in large whale order sizes during the downturn, suggesting that high-net-worth individuals and entities were actively de-risking into the liquidity provided by the drop.

While a single whale cannot crash the market, a synchronized exit by industry leaders can create a self-fulfilling prophecy.
When liquidity is thin and leverage is stretched, these “headline flows” signal to the broader market that “smart money” is de-risking, prompting smaller traders to follow suit in a bid to preserve capital.
The real drivers behind ETH's crash
While the narrative focused on founder wallets, the bulk of the crash was driven by three distinct market forces: leverage unwinding, ETF outflows, and macroeconomic headwinds.
Data from Coinglass indicated hundreds of millions of dollars in ETH liquidations over 24 hours during the worst of the move, with long liquidations dominating.
This created classic cascading conditions in which price declines trigger forced sales from overleveraged positions, which in turn trigger further declines and additional forced selling.

Simultaneously, institutional support evaporated. US spot ETH ETFs have recorded about $2.5 billion of net outflows over the past four months, according to SoSo Value data.
This occurred alongside much larger outflows from Bitcoin ETFs. This represents the kind of institutional de-risking that matters more than any one wallet when the market is already sliding.
Compounding these crypto-specific issues is the macroeconomic backdrop.
Reuters tied the broader crypto drawdown to a cross-asset selloff and tighter liquidity fears. The crypto market has shed about $2 trillion from its peak in October 2025, with roughly $800 billion wiped out in the last month alone, as investors reduced risk and leveraged positions unwound.

The purchase adds to Bitmine's growing Ethereum position during one of crypto's bloodiest weeks in recent memory. According to Arkham Intelligence, the fund's wallet now holds significant ETH reserves as the second-largest cryptocurrency struggles below key support levels.
Institutional Conviction Amid Market Carnage
Ethereum's current price action shows conflicting signals. While the token managed a slight hourly recovery, the 24-hour chart reveals a 0.45% decline. The weekly bloodbath has wiped out nearly 15% of ETH's value, dragging its market capitalization down to $251 billion according to CoinMarketCap.
Tom Lee's @fundstrat continues its contrarian strategy. The fund's latest $42 million buy came approximately five hours ago, demonstrating unwavering confidence despite widespread market panic. This accumulation pattern mirrors behavior seen during previous crypto winter periods when institutional buyers positioned themselves for future rallies.
Must Read: Ethereum Dips 22% in Week: Whales Buy Dip at $2,295 as Support Holds $2,250
ETH Price Faces Critical Support Test
The second-largest cryptocurrency by market cap now trades dangerously close to psychological support zones. Ethereum's 15% weekly decline has pushed prices into territory that typically triggers either capitulation or bounce scenarios. The token's performance lags behind broader market movements, suggesting deeper structural concerns beyond macro headwinds.

Bitmine's accumulation strategy raises questions about institutional positioning ahead of potential regulatory clarity or network upgrades. The fund's willingness to deploy $42 million during peak fear indicates strong conviction in Ethereum's long-term value proposition. Historical data shows similar whale accumulation patterns often precede major price reversals, though timing remains uncertain.
The broader crypto market continues experiencing severe volatility, with liquidations reaching extreme levels. Tom Lee's firm appears unfazed by short-term turbulence, instead focusing on cost-basis averaging into ETH at discounted levels. This approach has characterized Fundstrat's investment philosophy throughout previous market cycles.

Yi Li Hua's strategy is simple yet deadly: deposit ETH in Aave to borrow USDT, then buy ETH in a cyclical manner.
• Bull market is a printing machine: earn double with even a slight increase. 🚀
• Bear market is a shredding machine: when the price of coins falls, collateral shrinks, and in order not to be liquidated, one can only keep adding positions, ultimately forming a death spiral.

He believes ETH is undervalued at $3,000, but the market doesn't listen to your value judgment. When leverage is fully pulled, you are not investing in the future, but betting your life against short-term volatility.

🔍 DeFi transparency becomes a "sniper scope"
This is the cruelest part: in Aave, the liquidation price for large holders is completely transparent. When the entire market knows your bottom line is at $1,685, shorts will attack like sharks smelling blood. On-chain transparency leaves whales nowhere to hide during a crash! 🦈

title: Why Ethereum?
subTitle:
Ethereum is currently undergoing one of the most prolonged consolidation periods in modern crypto history. Since March 2024, it has been oscillating within a tight range between $2,000 and $4,000. However, when we zoom out to the macro level, we can argue that ETH has been trapped within this broader range since the end of the previous bull cycle in May 2021.
We are looking at five years of sideways price action.
The Fatigue of the Masses
This extended range movement has led to widespread exhaustion and frustration. Sentiment has soured to the point where "Ethereum hate" has become a common narrative. While it’s true that ETH has underperformed against Bitcoin over the last two years, I view this not as a sign of weakness, but as a massive accumulation phase in preparation for a new era.
The Calm Before the Greatest Expansion
The logic is simple: the longer the consolidation, the more violent the eventual breakout. I anticipate that this chart will conclude with the largest expansion we have ever witnessed, and I am positioning my investments accordingly.
Accumulating Ethereum below the $2,000 mark is, in my view, the opportunity of a lifetime. I do not expect ETH to remain below the $2,000 level for long. Once this five-year wait concludes, Ethereum will inevitably break out of this range, and the direction will be upward. Within the next two years, I believe Ethereum will outperform most other assets.
While the majority are blinded by short-term fatigue, the big picture suggests we are standing on the doorstep of history’s greatest market opportunity. The 5-year wait is nearing its end.
Why Multi Year Compressions Precede Historic Expansions?
GOLDHistory often repeats itself, and the current state of Ethereum mirrors the period when Gold was stuck in a tight range between $1,600 and $2,000 for four long years. Back then, the market mocked gold investors, labeling the asset stagnant while other sectors rallied. However, the moment Gold breached that range, it embarked on one of the most significant rallies in its history.
In financial markets, these types of prolonged accumulations are statistically biased toward an upside breakout. While timing the exact moment of the break is difficult, Gold’s surge caught many by surprise, the strategy for success remains constant:
Accumulate at Range Lows: The most profitable move is to buy when the price is at the bottom of the consolidation phase.Patience is the Catalyst: Once the position is set, it is a matter of waiting for the market to realize the underlying value.
Accumulation Leads to Aggressive Expansion
The outcome of such multi-year consolidations is almost always an aggressive expansion. In market cycles, the accumulation phase is the necessary pressure-cooker environment that precedes a vertical move. Ethereum is currently in that pressure cooker. When the lid finally blows, the move will likely be just as violent and decisive as Gold's historic breakout.
SILVER

T understand Ethereum’s potential, we must look at the historical relationship between Gold and Silver. Much like ETH today, Silver moved within a 5-year range. When Gold finally broke out, laggard capital rushed into Silver, anticipating it would follow suit. The result? While Gold increased 2.5x over two years, Silver, due to its smaller market cap, surged 4x in just one year.
This is a matter of pure liquidity physics. Currently, Gold sits at a $34T market cap, while Silver is valued at roughly $4T. Naturally, it takes significantly less capital to move Silver, leading to more aggressive and volatile price action.
The Anatomy of a Blow Off Top
If you examine the Silver charts closely, you’ll see a parabolic spike from $73 to $120 within just three weeks, followed by a sharp 40% correction in a single week. This is a classic "Blow-off Top." At the end of these aggressive cycles, market appetite becomes insatiable and volume explodes, causing price swings to become extreme. This is not a malfunction; it is a standard characteristic of late-stage parabolic moves.
If Ethereum can successfully exit this 5-year accumulation phase, sustain a position above $4,000, it will likely initiate a rally similar to Silver’s.
Because Ethereum’s market cap is significantly smaller than both Gold and Silver, the "expansion" phase will be far more violent. We should expect a vertical trajectory that culminates in a high-volume, high-volatility "Blow-off Top" the ultimate signature of a historic cycle ending.
Four different companies, four different types of accumulation, and yet the result is always the same: Expansion. To understand the current boredom surrounding Ethereum, we must look at its recent history. In 2021, Ethereum surged from $100 to over $4,000, a staggering 40x return that propelled it into the league of the world’s top 50 most valuable assets.
When an asset achieves this kind of scale in such a short window, a multi-year "rest" or consolidation phase is not just common; it is necessary. While many altcoins that saw similar 2021 rallies have since collapsed by -98%, Ethereum has maintained its structural integrity within a long-term range. It is now playing in the "Major Leagues," and its price action reflects the digestion of those massive gains.
The Safest Risk-Reward Ratio
We could pull thousands of charts across different accumulation types, and the conclusion would remain the same: Long-term consolidation is the precursor to a massive move. From a technical standpoint, Ethereum currently offers one of the most attractive risk-reward ratios for long-term investors. We are witnessing a high-conviction setup where the downside is limited by a multi-year floor, while the upside is a vertical expansion.
The market may be impatient, but the message of the chart is clear: the accumulation phase is nearly complete, and the transition to the expansion phase is inevitable.
The Million Dollar Question
The ultimate question remains: When will it happen, and how high will it go? Truthfully, providing a definitive answer to this is difficult. However, there is one key indicator to watch: The real rally will begin only when Ethereum climbs above $4,000 and establishes it as a firm support level.
Predicting the exact timing of this breakout is a challenge, but the structural preparation is undeniable. For now, the most important asset an investor can hold isn't just ETH, it’s patience.
Note: This is a personal market thesis based on historical patterns and public data. It is not advice.

Let’s break down what’s happening with Ethereum right now.
ETH is printing exceptionally high volume today — easily 2–3x the daily average — yet price is barely moving. At first glance, this confuses a lot of traders.

But this kind of behavior usually tells a very specific story.
What we’re likely seeing is heavy selling pressure being fully absorbed. A large number of sellers are exiting (many emotionally), and every sell order is being matched by strong buyers.
Result?
📊 Volume keeps rising
📉 Price doesn’t crash
📈 Price doesn’t explode — yet

This is classic absorption.
When this process completes — when sellers are exhausted — price typically responds fast and aggressively to the upside.

What Comes Next?
Once selling is fully absorbed, a sharp bullish expansion is expected.

First major resistance: just below $3,000
A move to $3,000 can happen very quickly
This recovery will not end at 3K — it’s only the first checkpoint

The correction phase looks complete. The structure, volume behavior, and price stability all point in the same direction. The market is preparing, not distributing.

Strategy Perspective
This zone represents one of the cleanest entries you’ll get.
Once price starts moving:
Volatility will spike
Swings will get aggressive
Entries will become emotional and difficult
Positioning before expansion is where things feel easy. After that, it rarely is.

Let's put it this way, trading can be fundamentally simple to the point where you think I’m trying to fool you.
The market looks complex, with all sorts of candlesticks, news, and funds… it seems like there’s a lot to learn. But the seasoned pros who actually make money often rely not on advanced techniques, but on something that most people can't achieve: self-control.
1. You understand the logic, but you can’t execute it.
When prices rise, they will fall; when they fall, they will rise. When a trend appears, follow it; during fluctuations, take fewer actions—these are things you heard on your first day in the market. Why don’t you believe it? Because of greed. Always thinking that you can’t miss any opportunity, even if the signal is unclear, you still want to give it a try. What about the experts? They would rather miss out than act on a market that doesn’t fit their rules. They are not smarter; they just have more patience.
2. Execution is a hundred times more important than technique.
You study countless indicators, stay up late reviewing, and still lose money. The problem often doesn’t lie in the technique, but rather in your inability to control yourself. The difference between experts and ordinary people is not who sees more accurately, but who follows the rules more strictly. Ordinary people get restless with a little fluctuation, while experts, like snipers, spend most of their time waiting and only pull the trigger when they are most certain.
3. Simple, but very tedious.
In essence, trading is: follow the trend if there is one, wait if there isn’t, and absolutely don’t touch what you don’t understand. Why do most people still lose money? Because they always want to complicate things, always thinking they can be the exception. The market isn’t complicated; what’s complicated is human nature. The way to make money is actually very tedious—repeating simple and correct actions. Always acting on impulse will definitely make you a victim.
So, stop fantasizing about some magical secret. Do less, wait more, and stick to your rules; that is better than anything else.

这么说吧，交易这事儿，本质可能简单到你觉得我在忽悠你。
市场看着复杂，什么K线、消息、资金…好像全是学问。但真正能挣到钱的老手，靠的往往不是多牛的技术，而是大多数人做不到的一点：管住自己。
一、道理你都懂，就是做不到
涨多了会跌，跌多了会涨，趋势来了跟着走，震荡时候少动手——这些你入市第一天就听过。为啥不信？因为贪。总想着每个机会都不能错过，哪怕信号不清也想去试试。高手呢？不符合自己规矩的行情，宁可错过也不乱碰。他们不是更聪明，只是更能忍。
二、执行力比技术重要一百倍
你研究无数指标，熬夜复盘，还是亏。问题往往不出在技术上，而是你管不住手。高手和普通人的区别，不在于谁看得更准，而在于谁更守纪律。普通人有点波动就心痒，高手像狙击手，大部分时间都在等，只扣最确定的那一下扳机。
三、简单，但很枯燥
说到底，交易就是：有趋势就跟，没趋势就等，看不懂绝对不碰。为什么大多数人还是亏？因为总想搞复杂，总觉得自己能例外。市场不复杂，复杂的是人心。赚钱的方法其实很枯燥——把简单正确的事，重复做。总是随心所欲胡乱操作，那肯定当韭菜。
所以，别幻想什么神奇秘诀了。少折腾，多等待，守好自己的规矩，这比什么都强。

Why is this? This is a classic sign of Absorption. We are witnessing a heavy clash between "misguided" sellers and institutional-grade buyers. The price isn't dropping because the demand is matching the supply perfectly, but it’s not rising yet because the selling pressure hasn't been exhausted.

Once this selling pressure is fully absorbed, the "supply overhang" will disappear. When that happens, we expect a strong bullish breakout.
Correction Status: The ABC correction is officially over. The signals are as clear as a cloudless sky.
The Target: Our immediate target is the $3,000 resistance level. Given the current momentum, ETH could hit this mark in a flash.

🚨$ETH /USDT: Is This the Bottom, or Just Another Trap? 🤔

Ethereum just took a hard fall to $1,747, and a lot of traders are wondering—are we done bleeding, or is there more pain ahead?

Let me walk you through what the charts are telling us right now.

What the Numbers Are Saying

The Momentum Meter (RSI) 
Think of RSI like a pressure gauge. When it drops below 30, the market is "oversold" meaning so many people have sold that we're due for a bounce. Right now, it's sitting at 44 and climbing. That's like seeing the panic subside. Sellers are getting tired, and buyers are starting to poke their heads back in.

The Price Channel (Bollinger Bands)
These bands show us where the "normal" trading range is. When prices break below the lower band (which happened at $1,737), it's like a rubber band stretching too far it usually snaps back. That's exactly what we saw. Ethereum bounced right off that level and is now hovering in the middle zone. The next logical target? Around $2,500, where the middle of the channel sits.

Trading Activity (Volume)  
Here's the interesting part: during that drop, we saw massive selling volume way more than usual. In trader-speak, this is often called a "capitulation event." It's when everyone who was going to panic-sell has already done it. The weak hands are out. The smart money? They're quietly buying up those discounted coins.

 So... What's Next?

Look, I'm not going to sugarcoat it the overall trend is still bearish as long as we're stuck below $2,500. But here's the thing: this level offers what we call a strong "risk-to-reward setup." Translation: the potential upside is much bigger than the downside risk right now.

If you're a long-term holder and you've been waiting for a good entry point, this might be it. Consider dollar-cost averaging—buying small amounts over time rather than going all-in at once. That way, if it dips further, you're not overexposed. If it rallies, you're already positioned.

title: Robert Kiyosaki’s Bitcoin Controversy: Conviction, Contradiction, and What Smart Investors Should Re
subTitle:
Robert Kiyosaki, the bestselling author of Rich Dad Poor Dad, has long been one of the loudest voices advocating Bitcoin as a hedge against inflation, fiat currency debasement, and systemic financial collapse. For years, he has urged investors to accumulate Bitcoin, gold, silver, and more recently Ethereum, positioning them as the ultimate lifeboats in what he frequently describes as a “fake money” world.
But a recent statement from Kiyosaki has ignited a wave of criticism across the crypto community—raising serious questions about consistency, credibility, and how investors should interpret influential market voices.
The Statement That Sparked the Backlash
In a recent post, Kiyosaki claimed that he stopped buying Bitcoin when it was around $6,000—a price level last seen in the aftermath of the COVID-era market crash in early 2020.
That claim immediately raised eyebrows.
Why? Because over the past several years, Kiyosaki repeatedly stated—publicly and confidently—that he was continuing to buy Bitcoin, even during periods when BTC was trading at significantly higher levels. In 2025 alone, he posted multiple times suggesting that price didn’t matter to him, emphasizing that he ignores short-term volatility and simply keeps accumulating assets he believes will survive the collapse of traditional financial systems.
At one point, those statements coincided with Bitcoin trading above $100,000.
The contradiction was impossible to ignore.
Crypto Community Pushback: Inconsistency or Misrepresentation?
Crypto analysts, traders, and long-term holders were quick to point out the apparent inconsistency. If Kiyosaki truly stopped buying at $6,000, then how do his later claims of active accumulation fit into the narrative?
This has led to two dominant interpretations:
The recent statement is inaccurate or loosely worded, possibly referring to a specific strategy or account rather than his overall Bitcoin exposure.
Some of the earlier “buying” claims were exaggerated, used more as motivational rhetoric than literal transaction disclosures.
Either way, the situation has reopened a broader debate around Kiyosaki’s public investment commentary.
A Pattern Under Scrutiny
This controversy didn’t emerge in isolation.
Over the years, Kiyosaki has made numerous bold predictions—including repeated warnings of imminent market crashes, dollar collapses, and banking system failures. While some of his macro concerns resonate with long-term structural risks, many of the specific crash timelines he predicted never materialized.
That history has now resurfaced, with critics arguing that his messaging often relies on fear-driven narratives rather than precise market accuracy.
Yet, supporters counter that Kiyosaki has never claimed to be a short-term trader. His philosophy, they argue, is rooted in decades-long wealth preservation, not perfect timing.
The Bigger Question: Does This Actually Matter?
For serious investors, the key issue isn’t whether Kiyosaki bought Bitcoin at $6,000, $60,000, or $100,000.
The real question is this:
👉 Are you outsourcing your conviction to public figures instead of building your own investment thesis?
Kiyosaki’s controversy highlights a critical truth about modern markets—influencers are not investment strategies.
Bitcoin’s value proposition doesn’t change based on who bought it or when:
Fixed supply
Decentralized monetary policy
Growing institutional adoption
Increasing relevance as a hedge against debt-driven economies
These fundamentals stand on their own.
What Smart Investors Should Take Away
Rather than dismissing Bitcoin$BTC —or blindly following personalities—this moment offers a powerful lesson:
Separate the asset from the influencer
Focus on long-term fundamentals, not soundbites
Use volatility as opportunity, not emotional noise
Build positions based on research, risk management, and conviction
Markets reward patience, discipline, and clarity—not tweets.
Final Thoughts
Robert Kiyosaki remains a polarizing figure—respected by many for popularizing financial education, criticized by others for dramatic forecasts and inconsistent messaging. This latest Bitcoin controversy reinforces one essential rule of investing:
The strongest portfolios are built on independent thinking—not borrowed confidence.
Whether $BTC Bitcoin is part of your strategy or not, the lesson is universal. In a world flooded with opinions, those who think for themselves will always have the edge.
And in volatile markets like crypto, that edge can make all the difference.$ETH

Ethereum whale behavior mein interesting shift nazar aa raha hai. Kuch whales ETH exposure increase kar rahe hain through OTC purchases aur borrowing, jabki doosre whales risk reduce kar rahe hain via tokenized gold aur stable balance-sheet moves.

Prominent figures bhi actively ETH offloading kar rahe hain. Ethereum co-founder Vitalik Buterin ne ETH convert karke charitable donations kiye, aur Aave founder Stani Kulechov ne 4,503 ETH (~$8.36M) beche, sirf hours pehle ETH price slide accelerate hone se.

ETH ka recent price ~$2,074 ke whale cost basis se neeche gir gaya hai — historically, yeh level ya toh violent snap-back rallies trigger karta hai ya multi-year lows tak further capitulation la sakta hai.
Institutional flows bhi risk-off sentiment dikha rahe hain. US spot ETH ETFs se past 4 months mein ~$2.5 billion net outflows dekhne ko mile, jo indicate karta hai ki institutional de-risking market par whales ke individual moves se zyada impact dal sakta hai.

Ethereum market ab critical level par hai, jahan whale behavior aur institutional flows future price direction ka major signal de rahe hain.

title: 《易理华清仓 64 万枚 ETH 背后：大佬也会“死于偏执”，普通人该如何活过 2026？》
subTitle:
兄弟们，心脏还好吗？
今天全网都在疯传易理华（Trend Research）清仓 64 万枚 ETH 用于偿还 DeFi 债务的消息。作为一个曾经喊着“每天都在买入以太坊”的死多头，他的离场让很多人对 ETH 彻底失去了信心。
但如果你只看到了“大佬亏了”，那你就还没看懂这个市场的残酷真相。
1️⃣ 方向对了，但杠杆错了
易大佬看好以太坊的逻辑——“金融上链、稳定币载体”，我依然认同。但他输在了对自己意志力的过度自信，输在了高杠杆下的连环踩踏。在 $60,000 的极端行情面前，市场不相信眼泪，只看清算价格。
2️⃣ 巨鲸的“血筹”，谁在接盘？
大佬断臂求生，抛出的这几十万枚 ETH 并没有归零，而是被更有耐心的机构和巨鲸在 $2500 以下悄悄分食了。这是一次财富的“大洗牌”，也是市场去杠杆后的必然过程。
3️⃣ 我们该学到什么？
如果你在这个 2 月份还没出局，请记住三点：
• 敬畏杠杆： 连圈内顶级大佬都扛不住的波动，你凭什么觉得自己能行？
• 人设会崩，K线不会： 别迷信任何人的喊单，盯着链上数据和机构持仓成本看。
• 换个赛道看机会： 当 ETH 在整理时，多关注币安 Alpha 频道提到的 AI 和 DePIN 赛道。
葫芦娃有话说：
大佬的倒下往往是阶段性底部的信号。不要在黎明前割肉，也不要在狂欢中梭哈。

你觉得易理华清仓是以太坊崩盘的开始，还是“最后一跌”的底部？
1. 底部已现，准备抄底
2. 还没跌透，继续观望
3. 彻底失望，换仓 SOL
欢迎在评论区留下你的坐标，点个关注，带你看清大户底牌，拒绝做下一颗“血筹”！

Ethereum co-founder Vitalik Buterin has reaffirmed that ETH (Ether) serves not only as the native token for the Ethereum network but also as a store of value and one of its most significant applications — a stance that underscores the evolving narrative around ETH’s utility and long-term value proposition. Buterin’s comments help reinforce the argument that ETH’s value isn’t solely derived from network activity but also from its intrinsic economic role within the ecosystem. 

Additionally, Buterin has personally aligned his economic outlook with this belief: in past remarks, he noted that he would not hold the majority of his net worth in ETH if he did not believe in its long-term store-of-value potential — illustrating confidence not just in Ethereum’s technology but in ETH as a durable asset amid shifting market narratives.

title: 这一场暴跌的源头到底在哪儿呢？
subTitle:
朋友们，二六年刚开年，大饼就暴跌，从9万八一路杀到6万， 
短短一周就跌去了30%。但是更可怕的不是跌幅，而是这一场暴跌。 
竟然没有任何真正的利空。 
如果你是老玩家，你一定会觉得这事儿非常的诡异。 
这要放在以前跌到8万或者跌到7万5的时候， 
咱们第一反应是什么，肯定是去翻筹码结构，算这个清算价格， 
是等着看这个多头会在哪儿反扑，对吧，但是这一次呢， 
最反直觉的地方来了，就是所有的技术指标全都失效了。 
那么大家来看一下这个大饼热力清算图的话，你会看到目前的盘面极度的荒凉。 
那除了9万美元附近，还有大规模清算的仓位，那到六万到八万这个至关重要的区间几乎是 一片空白。那这意味着什么呢？ 
这意味着，市场里接飞刀的人都没了。 
那以前的暴跌是因为下方有密集的追空单子。 
这些空头就像燃料一样，一旦。 币价触底反弹的时候，那么空头爆仓就会像这个连环炸弹一样把币价给推回去， 
就会形成一个漂亮的V型反转。 
但现在呢，6万到8万，这个之间没有密集的清算区， 
那么就是说，没有人敢在这儿做空，也就不会有人会被爆仓， 
那么多头就借不到空头平仓的推力。 
所以这不是一个普通的下跌。 
这是流动性的彻底枯竭，朋友们，那这就更离谱了。 
但如果说你回头去找原因的话，你就会发现这两天根本就没有什么具体的利空， 
首先，没有交易所跑路。没有任何大国宣布封禁，但他就是跌了， 
而且跌的毫无阻力。为什么呢？ 
因为这一场暴跌的源头可能根本就不在币圈，那到底源头在哪儿呢？ 
我来带大家一起找一找。 
其实啊，真相就在上周1月30号，Trump提名Kevin Walsh, 担任下一位这个联储主席， 
那消息一出呢，美元暴力拉升，那个加密市场单日蒸发。 
花了8000亿美元。那为什么这个男人的名字会让币圈如此恐惧呢？ 
因为啊，他不是普通的官员，他是美联储历史上最坚定的缩表狂魔。 
那早在08年金融危机的时候呢，当所有人都在喊着要印钱救市， 
他就是那个唯一的反对者，他公开反对QE two啊。 
他反复警告，大规模买入资产就是在制造泡沫。 
是在惩罚储蓄者。那就是这位男人。 
他带着手术刀回来了。你看沃什，他在二五年演讲中明确说到， 
健康的经济需要正的实际利率。 
那人为压低的利率只会制造虚假繁荣。 
那咱们来再对比一下数据，你就会明白这种窒息感。 
你看在20年放水时代，美联储的资产负债表从4万亿飙到了九九万亿， 
那个就是币圈的黄金时代，躺着就赚钱，那然后到了22年的加息周期， 
鲍威尔每月削减950亿美元，那大家都觉得非常难受了，赚不到钱了。 
了那再到26年的沃石时代。 
他的目标就是每月削减2000亿美元。 
那要在两年内把6.6万亿的负债表直接干到，砍到5万亿以下， 
这就是缩表狂魔的威力。 
他不仅要让美元变贵，还要让美元变少。 
那当全球流动性的这个抽水泵功率全开的时候， 
那大饼这种靠流动性溢出而支撑的资产最先感到窒息。 
当池子里的水干了，人们就开始疯狂的寻找替罪羊。 

曾经那位喊出二饼要破一万，永远看。 
看多永远热泪盈眶的华尔街发型最帅的男人AKA华尔街神算子汤姆利。 
这次啊，汤姆利也是踢到钢版上了，他旗下的这个基金， 
持仓400多万枚以太坊，那目前的账面浮亏是惊人的， 
达到了73亿美元，那唯一值得庆幸的是，他拿的是现货， 
虽然亏的肉疼，但是还不至于被踢出局。 
那就在1月底的这个访谈节目中呢？ 
Tom Lee, 他还信誓旦旦的说2400就是以太的铁底，结果呢， 
立马啪啪打脸，以太直接下探到了1800，但是另一位大佬trendresearch还有了得资本的老板易丽华， 
他的处境就危险多了，那易老板同样也是ETH的死忠粉， 
但是他用了杠杆，你看他根据这个链上数据分析， 
目前的盘面已经是贴着他的生死线在滑行了，那为了断臂求生， 
易老板不得不进行最痛苦的操作，就是在低位持续割肉， 
换取保证金，那换取空间。 
虽然说他已经拼命的把清算线从1800降到了1600，但是还是由于价格阴跌不止。 
它离爆仓反而越来越近。 
那现在的局面就是，只要以太再跌不到200美金，那这位行业OG就会面临被彻底的清算， 
那就在前几天的这个自白中呢，他也坦然承认了， 
自己判断失误，仓位决定思路，他这种对于以太的执念， 
让他上一轮攒下的利润疯狂回吐。 
易老板说到，身在行业中，总是时刻忍不住看多朋友们， 
那你们说，这只是几个人的悲剧吗？ 
其实并不是。易丽华那一句忍不住看多。 
其实是我们这一代，Web3圈内人共共同的肌肉记忆。 
那在26年开年的这场暴击里，其实就是在告诉我们每一个人之前， 
那个靠着减半预期还有大水灌溉就能躺赢的时代经彻底翻篇了。 
现在的圈不再是一个单纯的金融游戏。 
而是一个更加残酷、更加比拼生死底线的。一个竞技场，
朋友们，2026年，活下去比什么都重要。#ETH

9. Speak less and listen more; when speaking, it must be useful, and avoid ineffective socializing

12. Stop complaining; when encountering problems, look for solutions instead of complaining
13. Leave room for negotiation in conversations; see through but do not reveal, and give others dignity
14. Do not get tangled in trivial matters; focus on the core and key points, and avoid being stubborn
15. Treat others with discretion; differentiate between closeness and distance, and maintain boundaries
16. Do not procrastinate; complete today's tasks today, and do not accumulate hidden dangers
Self-Management (10)
17. Manage time; prioritize high-value tasks, and refuse ineffective busyness
18. Control desires, delay gratification, and do not be swayed by short-term temptations
19. Persist in reviewing; summarize gains and losses daily, and continuously optimize oneself

21. Actively learn; grow lifelong, and continuously fill cognitive gaps

​7. 跳出情绪看问题，理性优先于感性
​8. 承认世界多元，尊重不同观点，不强行说服
​言行举止（8个）
​9. 少说话多倾听，开口必有用，不做无效社交
​10. 言出必行，不轻易许诺，许诺必兑现
​11. 情绪稳定，遇事不慌，先冷静再应对
​12. 戒掉抱怨，遇到问题先找办法而非吐槽
​13. 说话留余地，看破不说破，给人留体面
​14. 不纠结小事，抓核心抓重点，不钻牛角尖
​15. 待人有分寸，亲疏有别，守住边界感
​16. 做事不拖延，今日事今日毕，不堆积隐患
​自我管理（10个）
​17. 管理时间，优先做高价值事，拒绝无效忙碌
​18. 管控欲望，延迟满足，不被短期诱惑裹挟
​19. 坚持复盘，每日总结得失，持续优化自己
​20. 保持自律，早睡早起、规律作息，养好身体
​21. 主动学习，终身成长，不断补认知短板
​22. 财务清醒，量入为出，攒钱抗风险，不盲目消费
​23. 控制注意力，不沉迷短视频，专注深耕领域
​24. 学会独处，享受孤独，在独处中沉淀自己
​25. 目标清晰，拆解落地，不做空想家
​26. 拒绝内耗型关系，及时止损，远离消耗自己的人
​人际相处（8个）
​27. 不再讨好所有人，只珍惜真心待自己的人
​28. 看人看本质，不被表面话术和情绪迷惑
​29. 帮人有底线，量力而行，不做无底线付出
​30. 感恩善意，礼尚往来，不占他人便宜
​31. 不干涉他人生活，尊重别人的选择和命运

quoteContent.body:
I don’t notice Dusk when things move fast.
I notice it when they don’t.

There’s a moment where activity keeps going but confidence doesn’t. Transactions submit. Apps respond. Nothing errors out. But people hesitate before acting on outcomes. That’s when you feel Dusk’s design, not on the happy path, but in the waiting.

Committee formation takes a little longer than expected.
Not broken. Just slower.
Ratification arrives, but without urgency.

On most chains, that delay would be papered over. Downstream systems would keep moving and fix the accounting later. Dusk doesn’t allow that shortcut. If the chain isn’t ready to certify an outcome, it simply refuses to turn “sent” into “settled”. Everything else has to live with that.

Hedger is the reason it feels this way.

Privacy here isn’t decorative. Confidential execution doesn’t mean “trust us, it happened”. It means nothing is final until it can be defended later, when the questions show up out of order. Regulators don’t ask politely or on time. Auditors don’t care how busy the network was. Dusk seems built for that reality, not for comfort.

The pressure shows up in boring places.

Queues get longer. Desks wait. Support teams start saying “still processing” without being able to promise when that changes. From the outside, it can look calm. Inside, the system is choosing restraint over speed.

DuskTrade makes this impossible to ignore.

When tokenized securities are involved, ambiguity is a liability. Either an obligation exists or it doesn’t. Dusk enforces that line hard. If committee certainty isn’t there yet, the platform slows instead of pretending. There’s no fast lane where activity continues and legality catches up later.

DuskEVM adds another layer to that feeling.
Solidity contracts run, but they inherit limits most EVM environments avoid. Hedger doesn’t care how impatient a developer is. What executes has to survive scrutiny later, not just pass tests now.

$DUSK  #Dusk @Dusk_Foundation
